invariants.rationale: If result is non-null, it probably contains at least one entry (based on the method purpose).
If result is non-null, its keys() method should be safe and non-null.
If result is non-null, its values() method should be safe and non-null.
If result is non-null, size must be non-negative.
If result is non-null and not empty, getting a value by a key yields a MapObject.
